intro: Te tia karaoa te bwai ae boou. I tararuai te mwakuri ni kaawakina server ae ASHIKA Network ao ana rabwata Minecraft server ae SABALISU, ao I karaoa te software ibukin Minecraft server ae Storia.
about: I tuai rabakau riki, ma I koroboki code n taai nako ao I a rikirake
I tararuai au mwakuri ni kaawakina server
Kam karaba n titiraki ibukin au mwakuri ke te technology: taku mauri n te Discord
can_write: Bwaai aika I kona ni korobokii (ma code aika aki raoiroi)
anw_t: ASHIKA Network: server man 30 yen n te namwakaina
anw_p:
Te mwakuri ni kaawakina ibukia aomata aika tangiria te server ma a aki kona ni kabongana mwane aika bati.
Moanna man te uarereke, **man 30 yen tii n te namwakaina**.
sab_p:
Karinna am Minecraft server n te rabwata ao kakaea aomata aika a na takaakaro iai.
E kakabwaia ibukia taan takaakaro aika ukoukora te server ao ibukia taan tauia aika tangiria n ota iaon aia server.
storia_t: Storia: te software ibukin Minecraft server aika abwabwaki
storia_p: Te open-source fork mai Folia ibukin Minecraft 26.2. Ma **Storia Cluster**, te aonnaba ae teuana e kona n mwakuri iaon server aika bati n te tai ae teuana, ao taan takaakaro a mwaing i buakoia n aki nooria te loading screen.
storia_points: **Storia Cluster**: te aonnaba ae teuana ae iangoaki irouia server aika bati, ma kaitibwaia aika encrypted
**Standby relay**: te relay ae kauoua e kawakina te kopi ao e na onea te moan relay ngkana e bua
**Linear format**: te aonnaba e kabongana tabeua te iterana n te disk space
**RAM world**, **Tick Guard**, te plugin API ibukin shared data, ao tabeua riki
